tweets.text: Sec. Duke: We are seeing a surge in terrorist activity because the fundamentals of terrorism have changed.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: We are seeing a surge in terrorist activity because the fundamentals of terrorism have changed.

tweets.text: (1/3) Sec. Duke: The primary international terror threat facing our country is from global jihadist groups.
tweets.text_resolved: (1/3) Sec. Duke: The primary international terror threat facing our country is from global jihadist groups.

tweets.text: (2/3) Sec. Duke: However, the Department is also focused on the threat of domestic terrorism.
tweets.text_resolved: (2/3) Sec. Duke: However, the Department is also focused on the threat of domestic terrorism.

tweets.text: (3/3) Sec. Duke: Ideologically-motivated extremists here in the United States are a threat to our nation, our people, and our values.
tweets.text_resolved: (3/3) Sec. Duke: Ideologically-motivated extremists here in the United States are a threat to our nation, our people, and our values.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: DHS is not standing on the sidelines as these threats spread, and we will not allow pervasive terrorism to become the new normal.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: DHS is not standing on the sidelines as these threats spread, and we will not allow pervasive terrorism to become the new normal.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: There is no longer a “home game” and an “away game.”  The line is blurred, and the threats are connected across borders.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: There is no longer a “home game” and an “away game.”  The line is blurred, and the threats are connected across borders.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: We are raising the baseline of our security posture across the board...Higher threat levels mean we need higher standards.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: We are raising the baseline of our security posture across the board...Higher threat levels mean we need higher standards.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: We are also making historic moves to keep dangerous individuals and goods from entering America illegally.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: We are also making historic moves to keep dangerous individuals and goods from entering America illegally.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: That includes building a wall on the southwest border and cracking down on transnational criminal orgs
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: That includes building a wall on the southwest border and cracking down on transnational criminal orgs

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: Our adversaries cont. to develop advanced capabilities online.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: Our adversaries cont. to develop advanced capabilities online.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: DHS is working closely with Congress ...to establish a new operating component dedicated to our cybersecurity mission.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: DHS is working closely with Congress ...to establish a new operating component dedicated to our cybersecurity mission.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: Our mission is critical.  But despite the dangers to our country, the American people will not be intimidated or coerced.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: Our mission is critical.  But despite the dangers to our country, the American people will not be intimidated or coerced.

tweets.text: Sec. Duke: I am committed to working with this Committee to forge a strong & productive relationship & work together to secure our homeland.
tweets.text_resolved: Sec. Duke: I am committed to working with this Committee to forge a strong & productive relationship & work together to secure our homeland.
